title: Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Training Notes: Election Wait and the Estate Pass-Through Discount Rate
content:
# Election Wait and the Estate Pass-Through Discount Rate

*Training notes — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).*

**The rule.** The estate pass-through discount rate is moved by how long the pass-through allocation has waited, the calendar days from its booking date to the election: a wait of no more than **90** days adds **-0.25** points; a wait of more than **365** days adds **0.5** points; any other wait leaves the rate unchanged.

## Questions answered

**Which date starts the wait?** The booking date of the wholesale-supplier pass-through allocation entry on the deceased member's capital account.

**Which date ends it?** The date on which the claimant makes the election.

**What does "adds -0.25 points" do to a rate of 5.0 percent?** It lowers it to 4.75 percent. Adding 0.5 points to 5.0 percent gives 5.5 percent. The change is in percentage points, not a percent of the rate.

**Is a wait of exactly 90 days a prompt election?** Yes; 90 is "no more than 90". A wait of 91 days leaves the rate unchanged.

**Is a wait of exactly 365 days a late election?** No; only a wait of more than 365 days, that is 366 or more, adds 0.5 points.

## Wait table

| Wait in calendar days | Change |
|---|---|
| 0 to 90 | -0.25 points |
| 91 to 365 | none |
| 366 or more | 0.5 points added |
